tables.table_description: Tracks the current inventory levels of each product at each store location, including stock thresholds and restock dates. Used for monitoring stock availability, identifying low inventory, and planning restocking activities.
tables.business_rules: {"rules": ["Each inventory record is unique per product and store combination.", "current_stock should not exceed max_stock_threshold.", "current_stock should be non-negative.", "restock_date must be today or a future date.", "min_stock_threshold and max_stock_threshold are set per product-store and guide replenishment."], "defaults": {"min_stock_threshold": 0, "max_stock_threshold": 9999}}
tables.related_tables: {"commonly_joined_with": [{"table": "TS.Product", "frequency": "high", "join_type": "INNER", "description": "To retrieve product details such as name, category, and description using product_id."}, {"table": "TS.Store", "frequency": "high", "join_type": "INNER", "description": "To get store information like location, address, and manager using store_id."}, {"table": "TS.Sales", "frequency": "medium", "join_type": "LEFT", "description": "To analyze inventory in relation to sales activity for each product and store."}]}
tables.common_filters: {"recommended": ["WHERE store_id = ?", "WHERE product_id = ?", "WHERE current_stock < min_stock_threshold", "WHERE restock_date BETWEEN ? AND ?", "WHERE last_updated_date >= ?"], "required": []}

columns.column_description: Unique identifier for each inventory record.
Unique identifier for the product.
Unique identifier for the store location.
Current quantity of the product available in stock at the store.
columns.synonyms: stock on hand, available stock, inventory level

columns.column_description: Date when the next restock is scheduled or expected.
Minimum stock level before a restock is triggered.
Maximum stock level allowed for the product at the store.
Date when the inventory record was last updated.
Number of units needed to reach the minimum stock threshold. Indicates how much needs to be restocked.
columns.calculation_formula: CASE WHEN current_stock < min_stock_threshold THEN min_stock_threshold - current_stock ELSE 0 END

columns.column_description: Number of units exceeding the maximum stock threshold. Indicates potential overstock.
columns.calculation_formula: CASE WHEN current_stock > max_stock_threshold THEN current_stock - max_stock_threshold ELSE 0 END

columns.column_description: Number of days remaining until the next scheduled restock.

tables.table_description: A comprehensive calendar dimension table providing mappings between Gregorian and fiscal dates, including holidays and weekends. Used to support time-based analysis, reporting, and joining with transactional data.

The name of the day of the week.

The month number in the fiscal year.

Name of the holiday if applicable, otherwise 'NA'.
Indicates if the date falls on a weekend ('Yes' or 'No').
Total number of holidays in the selected period.

tables.table_description: Contains the latest cost prices for products as provided by suppliers, including the date of last update. Used for procurement, pricing analysis, and supplier cost tracking.
tables.business_rules: {"rules": ["Each row represents the latest known cost for a product from a specific supplier.", "A product may have multiple suppliers, each with its own cost.", "Cost prices are updated as new supplier information is received."], "defaults": {}}
tables.related_tables: {"commonly_joined_with": [{"table": "TS.products", "frequency": "high", "join_type": "INNER", "description": "To enrich cost data with product details such as name, category, and attributes using product_id."}, {"table": "TS.suppliers", "frequency": "medium", "join_type": "INNER", "description": "To obtain additional supplier information (address, contact) using supplier_name or supplier_id."}, {"table": "TS.sales", "frequency": "medium", "join_type": "INNER", "description": "To analyze cost vs. sales price and profitability by joining on product_id."}]}

columns.column_description: Unique identifier for the product.
The cost price of the product as provided by the supplier.
Name of the supplier providing the cost price.
columns.examples: Sports Gear Inc, Fashion Wholesale Co, Beauty Supply Co

columns.column_description: Date when the cost price was last updated for the product-supplier pair.
Average cost price of products across all suppliers.
Most recent cost price entry for each product.
columns.calculation_formula: SELECT product_id, MAX(last_updated_date) as latest_date FROM TS.cost_of_products GROUP BY product_id

columns.column_description: Number of unique suppliers providing cost prices for each product.

tables.table_description: Contains employee records for retail stores, including personal identifiers, job roles, assigned store, monthly sales targets, and hire dates. Used for HR, performance tracking, and store staffing analysis.
tables.business_rules: {"rules": ["Each employee must be assigned to a valid store_id.", "Roles are standardized (e.g., 'Sales Associate', 'Store Manager', 'Senior Sales').", "Monthly sales target must be a positive integer.", "Hire date cannot be in the future."], "defaults": {"monthly_sales_target": 0}}

columns.column_description: Unique identifier for each employee.
Full name of the employee.
Identifier for the store where the employee works.
Job title or position of the employee within the store.

columns.column_description: Sales target assigned to the employee for each month.
Date the employee was hired.

columns.column_description: Number of employees assigned to each store.

columns.column_description: Number of years since the employee was hired.

tables.table_description: Contains historical and current selling prices and discount percentages for products, along with the effective date ranges for each price entry. Used to track price changes and promotional discounts over time for each product.
